intervals.quote: The first phase of the experiment, CDEX-1 [6], was installed and started operation in 2010 using a 1-kg single element pPCGe detector cooled by a cold-finger system.

summary.plain: The Chinese-led collaboration that builds germanium dark matter detectors, called CDEX, in the Jinping underground laboratory in Sichuan, China, optimised for very light dark matter particles.
summary.technical: China Dark matter EXperiment (CDEX) Collaboration: CDEX-1 (1 kg germanium), CDEX-10 (10 kg array in liquid nitrogen) and the planned CDEX-50, all p-type point-contact germanium detectors at CJPL. The 2013 first-results paper says the collaboration 'formally started a program aimed at the direct detection of low mass WIMP using a tonne-scale germanium array detector system'.
